displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EE4 (inducer and circulator blowers run continuously)
meaning: Flame sensed with no call for heat.
causes: Short to ground in flame sense circuit
diySteps: Technician: correct short at flame sensor or in flame sensor wiring
Technician: check for lingering or lazy flame and verify proper gas valve operation
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: immediately; flame with no call for heat can indicate a gas valve problem.
